name: Collectivists
corePosition: Collective Assembly decisions over the use of released resources.

fourPartyVariant.note: Retained in the four-party variant, absorbing the Universalists.

summary: A founding organisation favouring allocation through collective decisions of the Assembly rather than individual endowment or delegation.

name: Universalists
internalDivision: Limits on copying and the creation of new minds.

fourPartyVariant.note: Merged into the Collectivists when fewer than forty players participate.

summary: A founding organisation pressing for the standing of future people and digital persons in the allocation of cosmic resources.

name: Delegationists
corePosition: Delegate to the Council on Long-Term Values.
summary: A founding organisation favouring delegation of released resources to the aligned delegates of the Council on Long-Term Values.

name: Conservationists
corePosition: Settle the Milky Way; preserve what lies beyond.
internalDivision: Whether any far settlement is justified.

fourPartyVariant.note: Retained in the four-party variant, absorbing the Expansionists.

summary: A founding organisation favouring settlement within the galaxy while preserving resources beyond it.

name: Proprietarians
summary: A founding organisation favouring equal, individually held and transferable claims on released resources.

name: Expansionists

fourPartyVariant.note: Merged into the Conservationists when fewer than forty players participate.

summary: A founding organisation favouring settlement of all reachable space, divided over how much risk and speed are acceptable.
